name: Nilah
notes: Opens with Apotheosis (R) at t=0 if learned: it channels for gen.R.channelDurationS, ticking gen.R.numTicks times before its burst, and blocks attacks and other casts for that whole window.

After the channel (or immediately if R is not learned), Formless Blade (Q) is cast on cooldown for its line damage and its 4 s empowerment, and Nilah attacks continuously, gaining a 100% AD on-hit cone during the empowered window.
Slipstream (E) is treated as a 2-charge system: whenever a charge is banked it is spent immediately for its dash damage and its basic-attack-timer reset.

Formless Blade's crit-chance-scaled damage multiplier and Slipstream's/Apotheosis's AD ratios are computed once per item build since crit chance, crit damage and bonus AD do not change during a fight.

Formless Blade's passive (crit-chance-scaled armor penetration and crit-chance-scaled healing on hit) and Apotheosis's crit-chance-scaled healing/shield are not modeled: the engine gives a driver no way to reduce the target's effective armor for a self-granted stat, and healing/shielding never affects the damage fight.

Slipstream's real cooldown is taken from the wiki's per-charge recharge (26 to 12 s across 5 ranks, interpolated for the missing middle ranks) rather than the numbers-sheet's 0.5 s figure, which the wiki itself identifies as only the cast-queue gate, not the true cooldown; she is assumed to start the fight with a full bank of 2 charges.

Apotheosis's channel is read as 4 ticks at 0.25 s intervals (matching Riot's own in-game tooltip, which multiplies the per-tick number by 4) rather than the numbers-sheet's conflicting 6 ticks at 0.2 s.
Formless Blade's extra wave when cast during Slipstream's dash is not modeled: each ability is cast independently on its own cooldown/charge timer without a bonus stacking damage instance.
Jubilant Veil (W) is never cast: it is purely defensive/utility (dodge, ghosting, move speed, magic damage reduction, ally sharing) and deals no damage the dummy fight would register.
Mana is not modeled: Nilah's mana pool and regeneration at level 16 comfortably cover Q/E/R costs over an 8-15 s fight.

assumed.why: the wiki states only the recharge range (26 to 12 s) across 5 ranks; the three middle values are linearly interpolated
assumed she begins the fight with a full bank of 2 Slipstream charges, typical after any pre-fight idle time
